sampling: Restrict to development players with the already-declared date-eligible wrong-player donor (19/20 in deep-style v1). For each supported player, select the first whole validation game ordered by SHA256(seed:casefolded_player:game_id). For each decision and sample index, use one SHA256-derived uniform shared across arms and inverse-CDF sample over UCI-sorted legal moves.
wrong_player_control: Reuse the declared date-eligible 300-game donor mapping from deep-style v1 validation. The v1 sampled-policy protocol failed before scoring because it required all 20 players; v2 predeclares the known 19-player common-support restriction.
promotion_scope: Exploratory development-only sampled-policy guardrail. Report human similarity, reference soundness, mistake-size distributions, mates, player macros, and paired personal-minus-control intervals. Do not tune on confirmation players or claim generated-game fidelity.
